title: Confidential Meta Game
short: A VR multiplayer game funded by Meta about natural interactions with LLM agents.

sections.title: Project
sections.content: This unannounced VR multiplayer game has been my biggest project yet. I helped develop it alongside industry veterans while I took on significant responsibilities. Players interact with AI agents, powered by layered LLMs, viseme-driven emotions, generated voices, and flexible storytelling.

sections.title: Responsibilities
sections.content: I handled nearly all front-end Unity work, focusing on multiplayer and VR setup. I implemented gameplay features, art, maintained the Unity project, and optimized performance for Meta Quest 3 standalone.

sections.title: Client
sections.content: Confidential.

title: Year of the Cicadas
short: A VR project funded by Unity about exploring grief for losing a child.

sections.title: Project
sections.content: Year of the Cicadas is an immersive VR experience that guides the player through Kim Hieftje's grieving process after the loss of her son Cody. The cicadas play a significant role in the project, as they only surface every dozen years and happened to be swarming Cody's tombstone after passing away.

sections.title: Responsibilities
sections.content: During my time on the project, I managed interns who were contributing to the development, helping them connect the dots. After, I did a polish pass to ensure the project was ready for release.

sections.title: Client
sections.content: Kimberly (Kim) Hieftje is an Associate Professor of Pediatrics at Yale School of Medicine and co-director (and co-founder) of XR Pediatrics and the Yale Center for Immersive Technologies in Pediatrics. She leads research on immersive reality and serious games to promote health, behavior change, and education among youth.

title: Activision Blizzard Media Playable Ads
short: Built a modular pipeline for dozens of bite-size playable ads.

sections.title: Project Overview
sections.content: I've developed 40+ polished playable ads for Activision Blizzard Media's mobile game library, each served an average of 3 million times. I also helped build a modular platform that enabled rapid ad development and component reuse across campaigns.

sections.title: Responsibilities
sections.content: I handle the full process of coding, integrating art, and polishing the ads. This helps raise the overall quality and complexity of ABM's ad library. I also conduct R&D for ABM, e.g. for integrating ads into the Xbox interface following Microsoft's acquisition of Activision.

sections.title: Client
sections.content: I work closely with Senior Creative Director Brian Janelli on campaigns for clients including McDonald's, Walmart, Pepsi, Ben & Jerry's, KitKat, the UK Government, Honda, and many more.

title: Astro Harvest
short: Fast-paced space VR farming game balancing traversal, harvesting, and enemy encounters.

sections.title: Project Overview
sections.content: Astro Harvest is a cute fast-paced VR tower defense like game, where the user must harvest (the power of) fruit to combat a mysterious alien force. It's available to download for free online.

sections.title: Responsibilities
sections.content: I worked on many gameplay elements like the variety of turrets, bullets, and fruits. I was also closely involved in art integration and level design.

sections.title: Client
sections.content: Mantis Games is a small Belgian studio that I collaborated with, along with a few other developers, during my education. Together, we helped create their pre-alpha version.

title: Acorns & Glory
short: A game about hamsters fighting a war inside a cardboard box delivered at your door.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: I did nearly all coding, art integration, and a big chunk of the game design for this epic 48 hour game jam stint.

title: The Fizzler
short: A game about spraying champagne made on my own during GGJA 2025 while hosting the site.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
I built this game during the Global Game Jam Antwerp 2025 while also hosting the site, so most of the work happened after 10 PM. Being the first to rise and one of the last to sleep, I'm proud to have created my own game during the event.

The game itself is a playful gimmick where your friend urges you to keep buying champagne to impress a girl at the club. It has one of two endings...

title: Up With the Sub
short: A local co-op submarine adventure for a class project, voted as “Best Game of the Course 2020.” by our teachers.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
This project was created during the Game Projects course at DAE, a program where all majors come together to collaborate on a game. Together with two artists and another programmer, we successfully completed what became my first Unity project.

While learning the basics of Unity, I focused on implementing controllable characters, a simple crafting system, and the physics for both the items and the submarine.

Our project was highly praised by both students and teachers, earning the Teachers' Prize for Greatest Game of the Course of the Year. In 2025, I heard from my interns that it's still being showcased as an example during the course's introduction.

title: Cash Money
short: A game made for a DAE course using the school's custom game engine.

sections.title: Project Overview
sections.content: This is a 2-4 player local coop game that I developed for a school course. It's based on a minigame from the popular party game Pummel Party, where players must rob a bank and steal as much cash as possible without getting hit by cars.

sections.title: Custom Engine
sections.content: This project was developed in a custom C++ engine (partially) provided by my school, without any documentation. It was up to us students to create all the shaders used in the engine (text, sprites, post-processing, particles, shadow mapping, etc.).

title: Launch O'clock(down)
short: My first game jam ever ever, a game about exploring space and using gravitational pull to navigate 2D levels.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: My first game jam entry ever, a game about exploring space and using gravitational pull to navigate 2D levels. Avoid black holes, enter wormholes, see star constelations, and have fun!

title: Digigods
short: The very first multiplayer prototype of the well received game Digigods, helping raise USD 3 million.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: The very first multiplayer prototype of the well received and funded Digigods game on Meta Quest.

sections.title: Overview

title: ImmunoDeck
short: VR prototype exploring immunology concepts via game technology.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: VR prototype exploring immunology concepts via game technology.

title: VR Bicycle Simulation
short: Prototype simulating urban cycling scenarios in VR. This project was displayed during the cycling world championship 2021 in Leuven's City hall.

sections.title: Project Overview
sections.content: This is a prototype simulating urban cycling scenarios in VR. It was showcased during the 2021 Cycling World Championship at the City Hall of Leuven. It was also used in multiple scientific theses and will continue to be used by the city of Ghent.

title: GGJ Theme Committee + Site Organizer
short: Co-organizing the Global Game Jam Antwerp site and contributing in the GGJ theme committee.

sections.title: GGJ Theme Committee
sections.content: Starting from GGJ 2026, I'll be part of the GGJ Theme Committee. In addition, I'll be designing a trophy and certificate that other site organizers can (3D) print for their participants.

sections.title: GGJA 2025 & 2026
sections.content:
In 2025, I co-organized the Antwerp GGJ site. Thanks to our sponsors, we managed to host a free two-night on-site game jam (food/drinks/snacks included) with 65 participants.

During my spare time, I also developed my own game, The Fizzler. In 2026, I'm planning to do this all over again!

title: Company Trip Organizing and Planning
short: Organizing and planning the 15 years of PreviewLabs trip to America and Canada.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
I had the pleasure of completely organizing and planning the 15 years of PreviewLabs trip to America and Canada. This trip was all about connecting with colleagues and doing fun stuff. In addition, we met clients, did some teambuilding, and explored culture across the pond.

I was responsible for tasks such as booking the flights, making sure everyone had their travel authorization, ensuring everyone was briefed, and polling interests across the company to make sure everyone would have fun together participating in activities.

title: 3D Printing
short: Designing, printing, and painting custom parts, props, trophees, and miniatures as a hobby.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
Ever since I bought my Bambu Lab A1 printer, I haven't stopped 3D printing. I'm usually skeptical about whether a new hobby will stick, but this time I quickly knew it would.

I've also had the opportunity to use 3D printing professionally, designing and printing trophies for several game jams with up to 60 participants. More recently, I've become more involved with the GGJ, which gave me the opportunity to design a trophy for all site organizers to use and print.

title: Obstacle Course Instructor
short: For 4 years, I've worked with groups of children and adults, leading them over obstacle courses focusing on safety, movement, trust, and fun!

sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
For 4 years, I've worked with groups of children and adults, leading them over obstacle courses goin up to 24m in height. My focus was on safety, movement, trust, and mainly fun!

I did this at the company named Intense, who have a location in De Schorre and Hoboken.
